provenance_classification.explicit_simulation_notice: All three POMDP arenas (93A, 93B, 93C) are simulated closed-loop Kubernetes incident-triage environments parameterized from real-world public operational artifacts (Online Boutique Kubernetes RPC topology and 233 archived Statuspage incident histories). Discrete fault axes, remediation transitions, and asymmetric SLA dollar tiers ($10k-$250k) are design-authored around 100% live Adapt-1 API decisions.

exogenous_one_cloud_and_latency_referenc.equation_1_fork: When actions do not alter future exogenous outcomes, query the Adapt-1 joint forecast distribution once per step and score all candidate actions externally against the returned scenario cloud instead of invoking per-action sequential planning. Reserve stateful belief search (finite_world_belief_search / finite_world_qmdp / factorized_effect_belief) strictly for endogenous POMDPs where actions reveal hidden state or change subsequent states.

exogenous_one_cloud_benchmark.source_experiment: Exp 24 cross-vertical exogenous control A/B (1-cloud forecast + external optimizer vs per-action native planning across 3,625 scored steps)

inference_latency_profile.standard_regime_summary: < 900 ms median across standard archives and live belief-search/QMDP queries
inference_latency_profile.deep_archive_and_value_retrain_summary: ~2 s on deep multi-thousand-event archives and asynchronous neural value-model retrains

planning_mode_notes: Slot-symmetry ceiling in bound_transition: terminal_reward_map is shared across service slots and cannot natively encode asymmetric per-service SLA tiers ($10k-$250k) or heterogeneous probe execution latencies (1.5-5.0 min); offline local Bayesian/VoI/POMCP/20k-PPO peers exploit per-slot SLA and probe-cost metadata directly.

Tie-break premature-commit hazard: under 100% pure native API execution (zero client-side guards), finite_world_belief_search emits occasional premature commits on core_exploration_tie_break (50/50 premature commits in 93A).

QMDP 1-step full-observability approximation: belief_planning_mode='qmdp' (max_worlds=64) eliminates the 40.2 s exact-solver HTTP 504 timeout wall on 78,480 prior worlds (0 HTTP 504s, 562.7 ms production p50), but because QMDP assumes full observability after one step, it systematically undervalues pure information-gathering probes (-0.631 clean / -0.255 flaky vs +1.420 exact VoI).

Flaky-probe determinism assumption: under 15% transient probe timeouts (93B-Flaky15), Adapt-1 avoids zero-world crashes via graceful fallback when observations contradict all worlds, but lacks native probabilistic observation-noise likelihoods compared to NoiseAware_Bayes_Oracle / POMCP.
HTTP RTT vs local in-process compute: live REST p50 latencies span 438-765 ms/step (442.5-562.7 ms on production deployment) vs sub-millisecond local NumPy VoI/POMCP/PPO.
